## Agent role

Select one transparent role:

- product-manager-agent
- architect-agent
- backend-agent
- frontend-agent
- test-agent
- security-agent
- docs-agent
- reviewer-agent
- release-agent

## Objective

Describe the outcome the agent should produce.

## Business or enterprise challenge

Explain the risk, workflow friction, audit need, or enterprise adoption problem this solves.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The implementation or documentation change is complete.
- [ ] CAVRA evidence impact is documented.
- [ ] Tests or validation commands are listed.
- [ ] README, docs, wiki, and diagrams are updated when user-facing behavior changes.
- [ ] Human approval is requested for protected paths, security settings, release actions, or policy relaxations.

## Files in scope

List expected paths or modules.

## Out of scope

List anything the agent must not change.

## Required evidence

- Issue objective
- Branch name
- Changed files
- Policy impact
- Test results
- Documentation update status
- Human approval references, if required
